text:
elaine: FYI found a nasty env var shadowing bug in the sampleapp during key rotation — project-scoped key gets ignored and we fall back to the org key. customer hit 403s when rotating.

mike: can you paste a minimal repro? which SDK/language + sampleapp version?

elaine: node sampleapp v0.9.2. repro steps pretty short: set both ORG and PROJECT keys then rotate project. app kept using the old org key because our env lookup prefers REDWOOD_API_KEY earlier than REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY.

elaine: repro snippet:
```
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=org_live_ABC
export REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY=proj_live_OLD
# rotate project key
export REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY=proj_live_NEW
node sampleapp.js # still authorized as org_live_ABC
```

sam: ugh. I thought we had an explicit precedence table in SDKs. I remember python did project-first last quarter.

mike: right — JS and Rust SDKs currently use a different fallback chain than Python. JS: REDWOOD_API_KEY -> REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY. Py: REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY -> REDWOOD_API_KEY. That mismatch is dangerous for multi-key setups.

terra: how does this interact with ephemeral tokens / rotation? If a long-lived stream is open, does it pick up new project creds on reconnect?

elaine: long-lived streams reconnect but they re-run our credential discovery. because JS discovery prefers org key, reconnection re-auths as org key unless project key is explicitly set in config. So rotation doesn't fully take on reconnect.

dev-bot: Created issue #4287 in devex/sdk-credentials: "Env precedence parity: JS/Rust -> project-first; ensure streaming reconnect honors rotated project key" (link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/issues/4287)

mike: proposed immediate fixes:
1) unify precedence to project-first across all SDKs (configurable override still allowed)
2) update sampleapp to explicitly prefer project key in code (short-term patch)
3) add a quick onboarding note about how rotation works for long-lived streams

sam: +1. For (2) can we add a small guard in sampleapp that logs which key was used and warns if both present?

elaine: yes I'll open a tiny PR to sampleapp that logs `Using REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY` / `Using REDWOOD_API_KEY` and returns early with guidance link when both exist. That should help users noticing shadowing during onboarding.

mike: for SDK parity, I can take JS & Rust. Sam take docs + sampleapp patch? Terra can own streaming reconnect tests.

terra: got it — I'll add an e2e that rotates project key mid-stream and assert reconnect uses new key.

elaine: created draft PR for sampleapp logging: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapps/pull/691 — includes suggested wording and a note about rotation pitfalls.

sam: also proposing a small telemetry event for `credential.shadow_detected` so we can see how often both keys are set in prod and how many impacted reconnections. if we see high numbers, push a migration notice.

mike: good idea. file that under #4287 as a follow-up.

elaine: thanks all. I'll post an update in #product once sampleapp PR lands and we have an ETA for SDK parity.

mike: thanks — prioritize parity patch for JS in next sprint. :thumbsup:
